crossRefs.note: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live…
He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he…
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
translations.bsb: Then these men went as a group and found Daniel petitioning and imploring his God.
translations.kjv: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
translations.asv: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
